nginx_status.description: Last result written by the nginx watcher script; `null` until nginx reports.

leader.description: This replica holds the sync leadership (runs the scheduler and the stream sync).

running.description: A run of this task is in progress in this process.

display_name.description: Legacy column, no longer filled by the sync.

info.description: Routes users and agents to their department backend. Routing endpoints are public and served under the same paths through nginx; the original /routing/auth/backend-info/... paths (also under /api/v1/) are deprecated aliases answered with a Deprecation header. A key claimed by several backends answers 409 (ROUTING_CONFLICT_POLICY=reject). Admin endpoints need the admin account (HTTP Basic, or username/password in the JSON body). Errors are {"detail": ...} or {"<field>": [...]}.
